<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market Performance and Earnings:</strong> The Sensex and Nifty rallied significantly, driven by strong Q1 FY27 earnings from Bajaj Finance and broad-based buying from both FIIs and DIIs.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I12</a></span></li>
